blocks.text: 一百元的排骨便當　卡會安呢娘
blocks.spelling: tsi̍t-pà khoo ê pâi-kut piān-tong khá ē an-ne niâ

blocks.text: 公司的會計小姐　講明年薪水只剩安呢娘
blocks.spelling: kong-si ê huē-kè sió-tsiá kóng miâ-nî sin-suí tsí tshun an-ne niâ

blocks.text: 學校的主任找我　阮家小孩考試卡安呢娘
blocks.spelling: ha̍k-hāu ê tsú-līm tshuē guá tau ke kín-á khó-tshì khá an-ne niâ

blocks.text: 隔壁工廠是賊仔　種芭樂的溪水奈剩安呢娘
blocks.spelling: keh-piah kang-tiûnn sī tsha̍t-á tsìng pua̍t-á ê khe-tsuí nāi tshun an-ne niâ

blocks.text: 圓環的殺人事件　政府狗官青菜處理安呢娘
blocks.spelling: înn-khuân ê sat-lâng sū-kiānn tsìng-hú káu kuan tshinn-tshài tshú-lí an-ne niâ

blocks.text: 這條歌不是幹你娘　這條歌就安呢娘
blocks.spelling: tsit tiâu kua m̄ sī kàn lí niâ tsit tiâu kua tio̍h an-ne niâ
